name: Maratha Military Landscapes of India
description: Twelve forts scattered across Maharashtra, plus one far south at Gingee in Tamil Nadu, make up this network built or strengthened by the Marathas between the late 1600s and early 1800s. Some perch on rugged hilltops, like Raigad and Shivneri, while others, such as Sindhudurg, stand on the coast. Together they show how the Marathas guarded trade routes and held their territory.
